name: Stained Glass Sonata
scene: Jewel-colored original stained-glass rose windows and geometric sapphire, emerald and ruby panels in a midnight stone music conservatory, soft luminous shafts, exquisite architectural fine art.
icon: Dark leaded glass with ruby, sapphire and emerald stained-glass framing, tiny rose-window jewel and platinum tracery.

name: Firefly Railway
scene: A tiny countryside railway platform at summer dusk, warm brass lanterns, clover and tall grass, glowing fireflies, distant amber train lights, intimate painterly storybook landscape.
icon: Walnut-smoked glass with miniature station clock, lantern and tiny firefly jewels, moss enamel edging.
tagline: The last light stays for your song.

name: Porcelain Moon
scene: Elegant cobalt-painted ivory porcelain moon jars, delicate cloud scrolls, lunar discs and plum-blossom branches in a quiet ink-blue alcove, refined ceramic still life.
icon: Cobalt-and-ivory glazed porcelain trim around dark blue glass, fine painted cloud curls and a tiny crescent ceramic charm.

name: Black Honey
scene: Obsidian mineral slabs, translucent amber honey chambers, tiny gilded bee and sculptural honeycomb in a dramatic black botanical still life, warm gold refracted light.
icon: Obsidian glass filled with translucent dark honey, gold honeycomb corners and one tiny elegant bee charm.

name: Sakura Arcade
scene: Nostalgic Japanese arcade entrance at dusk beneath cherry blossoms, violet game cabinets, coral buttons and cyan rain reflections, original hand-painted anime city scene, abstract screens with no text.
icon: Violet glass with coral enamel arcade buttons, tiny joystick and translucent cherry blossom petals.
tagline: One more song. One more life.

name: Cloud Post Office
scene: Floating sky islands with tiny ivory and sky-blue post-office cottages, miniature envelopes flying between soft cream clouds, gold sun rays, original whimsical cut-paper storybook world.
icon: Sky-blue smoked glass framed by pearly clouds, tiny enamel envelope and miniature red mailbox charm.

name: Copper Canyon Radio
scene: Weathered copper radio observatory in a red desert canyon, turquoise mineral seams, antenna silhouettes and a glowing analog dial, cinematic painted sunset, no lettering.
icon: Weathered copper rim and dark turquoise glass, miniature analog tuning dial, engraved antenna lines and mineral inlays.

name: Midnight Aquarium
scene: A tranquil midnight aquarium with translucent pink jellyfish, luminous sea-glass plants, fine coral silhouettes and deep teal water, magical underwater illustration.
icon: Deep teal aquarium glass with miniature translucent jellyfish, pearl bubbles and coral-pink edging.

name: Sunday Bakery
scene: Cozy neighborhood bakery window on a gentle Sunday, strawberry pastries, croissants, buttercream ceramics, gingham paper and warm espresso, hand-painted original cozy still life, no lettering.
icon: Espresso glass with buttercream ceramic trim, tiny strawberry pastry and sculpted croissant charm, warm pink highlights.

name: Rose Circuit
scene: Luxury black ceramic and rose-gold circuit board architecture, precise glowing fine traces, smoked crystal modules and sculptural futuristic rose forms, cinematic restrained technology still life.
icon: Black ceramic glass with precise rose-gold circuit etchings and small crystalline rose node, clean luminous edges.

name: Clockwork Garden
scene: Antique brass clock mechanisms inside an ivy-filled glass terrarium, tiny fern leaves, a delicate clock face and warm sun motes, intricate botanical mechanical diorama, no readable numerals or letters.
icon: Smoked olive terrarium glass, miniature brass clock gears, ivy leaves and one tiny clock face framing the center.

name: Snowglobe Village
scene: A tiny village of snowy blue rooftops and warm amber windows inside a delicate glass snowglobe, winter pines, deep midnight blue and soft pearl snow, cozy original miniature illustration.
icon: Midnight-blue snowglobe glass with miniature snowy rooftops along base, pearl snowflakes and warm window jewels.

name: Indigo Atelier
scene: Japanese indigo denim textiles, cream sashiko stitching, copper rivets, folded fabric and quiet handcrafted tools, sophisticated tactile editorial still life with original stitched geometric motifs.
icon: Indigo-textured dark glass with cream sashiko-stitched edge pattern, copper rivets and subtle woven depth.

name: Prism Playground
scene: Translucent acrylic arches, stacked cobalt, coral and lemon geometric toys, pearly clear spheres and sculptural light refractions in a playful original design playground, no characters or lettering.
icon: Layered translucent acrylic dark case, cobalt, coral and lemon modular geometric edges, polished clear prism corners.

name: Silent Cinema
scene: Elegant black-and-white film photograph of a quiet vintage cinema foyer, silver film grain, velvet seats, a luminous projector beam and one restrained red ticket accent, original cinematic composition, no text.
icon: Black-and-white silver glass framed by a film-strip window, tiny projector lens and restrained red ticket charm.

name: Riverside Pause
scene: Original hand-painted anime river beneath a monumental bridge, charcoal pillars, silver-gold sun glitter, small figure and friendly fluffy dog on a wooden pier, pigeons above water, serene unplugged afternoon. No error message, no dinosaur graphic, no lettering.
icon: Charcoal glass with shimmering silver-gold river ripples, miniature pier, tiny dog charm and bridge-arch frame.

name: Pixel Stargazer
scene: Exquisite original pixel-art Milky Way in cyan, indigo and dusty pink above a dark rocky stargazing summit, carefully placed crisp pixel stars and one quiet distant planet. No text or quotes.
icon: Obsidian glass containing miniature pixel-art cyan-pink galaxy along edges, tiny stepped summit and diamond pixel stars.
tagline: A thousand stars. One favourite song.

name: Roaming Cosmos
scene: Original hand-painted anime blue camper van in golden meadow at night, warm cabin lights, tiny traveler sitting on roof, vast sapphire star sky, distant twilight horizon, cozy road-trip wonder. No brands, no error messages, no lettering.
icon: Sapphire glass with miniature blue camper van and golden meadow along base, warm headlamp jewels and starry roofline.

name: Blue Hour Sanctuary
scene: Original moonlit blue wisteria garden sanctuary: cascading periwinkle flowers around an arched garden gate, pale blue grasses, pink wildflowers, floating warm lanterns over a narrow reflective stream, serene painterly depth. Distinct garden composition, not a single-tree portrait. No lettering.
icon: Midnight moonstone glass with sculpted blue wisteria arch, tiny warm lantern and pink blossom jewels around lower corners.
tagline: Leave a little room for wonder.

name: Celestial Current
scene: Original flowing oil-painted deep blue celestial river, pale gold tiny fish swimming through lavender and sapphire brushstroke currents, scattered warm stars, rose and yellow glowing specks, elegant dreamy aquatic cosmos. No letters.
icon: Deep sapphire liquid glass with miniature pale-gold fish, pearl star trail and lavender oil-swirled currents around the rim.
